text_raw: I have recently contacted imperial group to get a better energy rate for my business office. I spoke to one of the team. Not only did he find a great rate for me and also saved me £800 a month! Highly recommend imperial group, they take all the hard work and hassle out of dealing with contracts etc. couldn’t reccomend any more.

This is the first time ordering from here and my items are gorgeous… the pictures don’t do them justice! The items are beautiful, the packaging is gorgeous and they arrived very quickly. Communication was spot on, attention to detail was 100% so would without any doubt recommend this company!

Not what is hoped. I've just booked a holiday through Laura Evans at Holidays Please.  I can't comment on the holiday yet as I don't go until October but I have been very pleased with the booking process.  I consulted with a couple of travel agents and chose to book through Laura as she was the one who took the time to ask the right questions and found options that were absolutely tailored to our preferences.Hotel Venice was a big disappointment.  The canal views we were promised were of a nasty enclosed bin yard and staff were appalling. Contacted agent who promised the world but delivered sweet nothing.  The supposed business class flight home was a joke.  Whilst these issues weren't directly the agents fault, simple diligent research would have uncovered issues raised by others.

Poor packaging good communication. Unfortunately the item arrived damaged. I do not think the packaging was suitable for such a fragile item- ceramic bird bath. However, communication was good and I received a timely refund once the issue was identified. Perhaps look at delivery methods going forward. Thank you.

This review is for CAROLYN KELLYCustomer Service of ValdaAfter our huge-huge issue stemming from a Broker ( see older reviews )Carolyn got in touch with myself as she posted on my review.She took information regarding the contract and supply problem along with associated problems created.She kept in touch daily - updating me on what was happening until my supply was put back to my original company via an erroneous transfer, then asked for verification my supply was back so she could close the case.Carolyn ALSO listened to the issues I had with my contract being changed out of my name and how this caused SO much distress as I could not speak with anyone - no longer being the account holder.A sneaky loop hole to close asap!IF ONLY ALL THE STAFF were this helpful Valda.Thank you Carolyn Your help was very much appreciated If I could give you personally 5 stars I would.

A scan with an Attitude.. All I can say is that I'm glad I had the scan as it answered some questions. As for the staff it was a tale of 2 stories. The receptionist was very pleasant but the lady that performed the ultrasound was very rude and abrupt. All I can say is she needs to learn some bedside manners, it goes a long way.

Poor Packaging. This would have been 4 stars if it wasn't for the packaging that was used to ship the lenses to me.They were cardboard boxes, completely wrapped in sticky tape to effectively make them more sturdy & waterproof.  This made the packages very difficult to transport once they were in my possession - delivered to work address in London and I needed to take them home in Surrey.Other companies I've used have provided proper hard cases and I suspect Lenses for Hire have gone down a different route in order to save on costs.Please consider investing in hard cases!
